name: swdraw
description: Spec-driven SolidWorks drawings with self-checking dimensions, revisions, reference-safe renumbering, folder tidy and a drawing register.
long_description: Local Windows MCP server. Builds the active SolidWorks drawing from a YAML spec (views, sections, details, dimensions checked against expected values, tolerances, GD&T, notes, title block, house-style fonts, PDF/PNG export), applies revisions, renumbers parts and drawings without breaking references, tidies working folders and generates a drawing register workbook. Requires a local SolidWorks installation and uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/), which installs Python and the dependencies on first run.
